versions.changelog:
Initial release of anytocopy-extractor.

- Enables extraction of video captions from platforms like Douyin and Xiaohongshu via anytocopy.com.
- Supports over 50 platforms, offering features such as watermark-free video download, audio extraction, and image watermark removal.
- Provides extracted content including title, main text/script, and optional media links.
- No login required; fully browser-based workflow.
